newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila PHIBOR rates largely lower on excess funds.
newsitem.headline: Manila PHIBOR rates largely lower on excess funds.

text.p: Philippine interbank offered rates (PHIBOR) were mostly lower on Tuesday on the back of weaker overnight and Treasury bill rates, traders said.
The weakening domestic rates were due to high liquidity in the market.
The overnight money slipped to 10.90625 percent earlier in the day from 11.71875 percent on Monday. The Treasury bill rates likewise declined across all maturities during Monday's auction.
PHIBOR are average rates of foreign exchange forward rates quoted by 20 banks operating in the country.
